records.text: Anonymous tipsters told Candace Owens that some church attendees were told pastors learned of Charlie Kirk's death early because of contacts in the Israel Defense Forces.
records.speaker: Church-contact tips alleging early death knowledge via IDF contacts (identities unverified)

appearances.snippet: And, you know, I haven't exactly hunted down this rumor, but I did receive a few tips into our inbox that that is the reason that people who attended church were given as to why some of these pastors knew Charlie was dead before somebody else because of their contacts in the IDF. Again, I need to chase down those leads, but yeah, they have a pretty good.

links.title: Tips Link Early Death Knowledge to IDF Contacts
